question: For which form of dance did Vempati Chinna Satyam receive the Padma Bhushan in the year 1998?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vempati Chinna Satyam** was an acclaimed Indian dancer and teacher who brought immense recognition to the classical dance form of **Kuchipudi**.
 
• **Kuchipudi** is one of the eight major classical dance forms of India, with its origins in the village of **Kuchipudi** in the Indian state of **Andhra Pradesh**.
